risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI Agent Data Pipeline & Input Integrity, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to R-SA-1, R-AI-1, R-AI-2, R-IP-2, R-IP-3, R-IP-5, and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack (MT-29).

compensating_control_1.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure policies, processes, procedures and practices related to the mapping, measuring and managing of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risks are in place, transparent and implemented effectively.
compensating_control_1.justification: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance (AAT-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Data Pipeline & Input Integrity (AAT-39.5) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_2.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Data Pipeline & Input Integrity (AAT-39.5) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
